title: St. Somewhere | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Amazing Third-Floor Balcony Lounge* Just One Block from the S Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool  Seacrest Beach Resort Pool* 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Amazing Third-Floor Balcony Lounge* Just One Block from the S Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool Seacrest Beach Resort Pool* 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest so we can further assist!Welcome to St. Somewhere, a stunning 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom beach home designed to comfortably accommodate up to 13 guests and create unforgettable family memories along 30A. Ideally located just one block from the award-winning 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Beach Resort pool, guests can enjoy fountains, Jacuzzis, and a kiddie pool, while the beautiful 30A beaches are just an easy trip away. Inside, the spacious open-concept first floor features a large living room with seating for eight, a 55” Smart TV with surround sound, a dining area for eight, and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, and a breakfast bar with seating for four. The first-floor master suite offers a comfortable king bed, a Smart TV, and a private bathroom with a double vanity and tiled shower. Upstairs, the second floor features three additional king bedrooms, including one with a private ensuite bath and two sharing a Jack & Jill bathroom with a double vanity, with each bedroom equipped with a 42” Smart TV. The third floor is perfect for kids, featuring a fun bunk room that sleeps five, its own full bathroom, and a 42” Smart TV with cable and streaming options. One of the home’s standout features is the spectacular third-floor balcony lounge, complete with seating for 11, a dining table for six, an outdoor kitchen prep area with sink and mini fridge, and a large flat-screen TV—ideal for morning coffee, family meals, movie nights, or evening cocktails. A second-floor balcony with seating for six provides another peaceful spot to relax, making St. Somewhere the perfect home base for enjoying the pool, beach, and everything the 30A area has to offer! The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed2nd Floor: Guest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: King Bed3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom 4: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds + Twin BedSeacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world-class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year! *Parking passes will be provided equal to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home. *Area Attractions: Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old-World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay, play, and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted seabed. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
